title: Incidence of immunotherapy-related hyperprogressive disease (HPD) across HPD definitions and cancer types in observational studies: A systematic review and meta-analysis

claims.text: Pooled incidence of HPD across 34 observational studies is 12.4%
claims.location: Abstract (Results); Results paragraph 4 ('The overall estimated incidence of HPD was 12.4% (95% CI, 10.2%–15.0%)'); also reported there: I2 = 72%, 95% PI 4.5%–29.7%; 558 events / 4117 patients
claims.notes: Pooled incidence % from rma.glmm(PLO, ML, test='t'), back-transformed; t-based 95% CI 10.2-15.0%, 95% PI 4.5-29.6%, I2=78.7%, k=34, events/N=558/4117.

claims.text: Significant between-study heterogeneity in HPD incidence (Cochran Q)
claims.statistic: Cochran Q test for heterogeneity (df = 33 implied)
claims.notes: Wald-type heterogeneity Q (QE.Wld) from rma.glmm, df=33. LRT Q=141.88 (sensitivity.json). meta::metaprop Wald Q=119.32; meta I2=72.3% (metafor I2=78.7%).

claims.text: Advanced gastric cancer has higher odds of HPD than RCC, adjusted for definition type
claims.statistic: adjusted odds ratio from multivariable meta-regression (AGC vs RCC)
claims.location: Table 1, row 'AGC'; Abstract; Results paragraph after Figure 4
claims.notes: Adjusted OR AGC vs RCC from rma.glmm(PLO, ML, test='t', mods=~histology+definition; ref RCC, C); t-based 95% CI 3.13-37.47, df=27.

claims.text: Hepatocellular carcinoma has higher odds of HPD than RCC, adjusted for definition type
claims.statistic: adjusted odds ratio from multivariable meta-regression (HCC vs RCC)
claims.notes: Adjusted OR HCC vs RCC from rma.glmm(PLO, ML, test='t', mods=~histology+definition; ref RCC, C); t-based 95% CI 2.41-26.49, df=27.

claims.text: NSCLC has higher odds of HPD than RCC, adjusted for definition type
claims.statistic: adjusted odds ratio from multivariable meta-regression (NSCLC vs RCC)
claims.notes: Adjusted OR NSCLC vs RCC from rma.glmm(PLO, ML, test='t', mods=~histology+definition; ref RCC, C); t-based 95% CI 2.25-22.71, df=27.

claims.text: Definition B (TGK ratio >= 2) yields higher HPD incidence than Definition C (RECIST PD + deltaTGR > 50), adjusted for tumor type
claims.statistic: adjusted odds ratio from multivariable meta-regression (definition B vs C)
claims.location: Table 1, row 'B (Saâda-Bouzid et al)'; Abstract; Results paragraph after Figure 4
claims.notes: Adjusted OR definition B vs C from rma.glmm(PLO, ML, test='t', mods=~histology+definition; ref RCC, C); t-based 95% CI 1.05-3.15, df=27.
